color.note: Three inks: temple teal, black, white. The UI tokens flip between themes; the brand-* tokens stay the same. The ink-* tokens give each of the three brands one ink: 西顶艺术 ink-arts, 西顶教育 ink-academy, 西顶时光 ink-lifestyle. The vi-* tokens (v1.8) are the source VI's six swatches, kept for reference and signage; no component uses them yet.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. A cool grey-green paper in light, pure black in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tiles, tables and cards sitting on paper. Also the label colour on an ink or teal-text fill.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines on paper and surface (18.6:1 and 21:1 in light, 21:1 and 17.5:1 in dark). Also the selected segment and primary button fill, with surface as the label colour.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints and captions on paper and surface (6.4:1 and 7.2:1 in light, 10:1 and 8.4:1 in dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel, tile, table and field borders. Decorative: about 1.5:1 on surface, so pair it with a label or a fill wherever it marks a control (the source uses it for field borders).

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Temple teal as an accent in the UI: swatches, rings, large shapes, the mark on surface. Holds 3.6:1 on surface and 3.2:1 on paper: use it for shapes and for type at 24px and above. Body text in teal uses teal-text.

tokens.name: teal-text
tokens.usage: Teal that reads as text: links, table row labels, the one-letter labels on a card, on paper and surface (5.8:1 and 6.5:1 in light). Also the hover fill of a button, with surface as its label colour.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: a solid 2px outline, 3px offset, on paper and surface (6.8:1 or more in light, 9:1 or more in dark).

tokens.name: brand-teal
tokens.usage: Temple teal, the brand field: card fronts, covers, posters. The mark and 24px+ type sit on it in brand-white (3.6:1). Small white text on it misses 4.5:1: the source card's 6pt brand row on teal is kept as drawn and flagged.

tokens.name: brand-black
tokens.usage: Black, the second field and the black mark. brand-white on it for the White-on-black colourway.

tokens.name: brand-white
tokens.usage: White, the third field and the mark on brand-teal and brand-black. The same in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-arts
tokens.usage: 西顶艺术 (Xiding Arts): its fields, card grounds and tags. Temple teal in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-academy
tokens.usage: 西顶教育 (Xiding Education): black in light, white in dark, so its field always stands out from paper.

tokens.name: ink-lifestyle
tokens.usage: 西顶时光 (Xiding Lifestyle): the open field. Fill it with surface and draw its edge with a 1px ink line; the line carries the shape.

tokens.name: on-ink-arts
tokens.usage: Type on ink-arts at 24px and above, or bold at 19px and above (3.6:1). Smaller text for 西顶艺术 sits beside its field on paper.

tokens.name: on-ink-academy
tokens.usage: Type on ink-academy (21:1 in light, 17.5:1 in dark).

tokens.name: on-ink-lifestyle
tokens.usage: Type on ink-lifestyle (21:1 in light, 17.5:1 in dark).

tokens.name: ink-root
tokens.usage: 担当, the ground under the three brands: the fourth row of the scene menu and its tags. Drawn on paper with a hairline edge.

tokens.name: on-ink-root
tokens.usage: Type on ink-root.

tokens.name: guide-trim
tokens.usage: Print proofs: the dashed trim line on a business card.

tokens.name: guide-safe
tokens.usage: Print proofs: the dotted 4 mm safe-area line.

tokens.name: vi-teal
tokens.usage: VI teal (v1.8, source VI 品牌形象-5). The VI's teal: the symbol's square and the signage light box. Close to brand-teal (#628F8A) but not the same; which one the brand uses is an open decision.

tokens.name: vi-red
tokens.usage: VI red (v1.8, source VI 品牌形象-5). Temple red, the VI's second-largest swatch. Not yet used by any component.

tokens.name: vi-sand
tokens.usage: VI sand (v1.8, source VI 品牌形象-5). Sand. The VI ships a sand lockup and wordmark for dark grounds.

tokens.name: vi-mauve
tokens.usage: VI mauve grey (v1.8, source VI 品牌形象-5). Mauve grey, a small accent swatch. Not yet used by any component.

tokens.name: vi-ivory
tokens.usage: VI ivory (v1.8, source VI 品牌形象-5). Ivory, the VI's paper. The VI ships an ivory lockup and wordmark for dark grounds.

tokens.name: vi-charcoal
tokens.usage: VI charcoal (v1.8, source VI 品牌形象-5). Charcoal, the nameplate's field on the signage page; the VI's black.

families.sans: "Instrument Sans", "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

groups.name: Wordmark
groups.note: The three lines of every lockup. Sizes here are specimens: in a lockup they are set from the mark's dot rows.

styles.name: wordmark-zh
styles.usage: The Chinese wordmark, Noto Serif SC Bold, opened 0.04em (0.06em when stacked).

styles.name: wordmark-latin
styles.usage: The Latin line under or beside 西顶: Instrument Sans Medium, capitals, tracked 0.42em (0.46em on a card).

styles.name: brand-row
styles.sample: 西顶艺术　西顶教育　西顶时光
styles.usage: Sub-brand names under the mark, joined by the pair dot.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Songti for anything said aloud. One headline per view.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Covers, posters, the first slide. Added for XIDING EDUCATION material.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Instrument Sans for text that is read. Chinese body text falls through to the system sans.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 艺术 · 教育 · 生活方式。西顶艺术、西顶教育、西顶时光。

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Xiding Education, 西顶庙, Haidian, Beijing.
styles.usage: The one line under a title, in muted, up to 46 characters wide in Latin.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Shared by all three cards, on the front under the mark.
styles.usage: Hints, figure captions, tile labels, in muted.

spacing.note: The steps the mark studio uses: 20px is the panel step, 12px the tile gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a label and its control; between stacked buttons.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Tile gaps; button padding; table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Smallest page margin; column gap at narrow widths.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Panel padding and the gap between groups inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between columns; cover margins.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Largest page margin; smallest gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-72
tokens.usage: Largest gap between sections.

radius.note: Corners are nearly square; the dots are round.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, segments, fields.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, tiles, tables, the stage.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Dots and colour swatches.

shadow.note: The UI is flat. Shadows lift a printed card off the page in a mockup.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Business-card mockups at full size.

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: Business-card thumbnails.

mark.note: The mark's geometry in source pixels (a 1200-unit field, centre 600, 714). 32 marks, 40 circles, 8 rows.

tokens.name: mark-width
tokens.usage: Ink width of the mark, x 178 to 1022.

tokens.name: mark-height
tokens.usage: Ink height of the mark, y 36 to 1392. Every placement scales from this.

tokens.name: mark-dot
tokens.usage: Dot radius in the Dot style; the outer radius in the Circle style.

tokens.name: mark-point
tokens.usage: Dot radius in the Point style.

tokens.name: mark-ring
tokens.usage: Line weight in the Circle style (1 to 16).

tokens.name: mark-pair
tokens.usage: Half the distance between the two circles of a paired mark.

tokens.name: mark-clear
tokens.usage: Clear space on every side of the mark: nothing else enters it.

tokens.name: card-width
tokens.usage: Trim width, landscape.

tokens.name: card-height
tokens.usage: Trim height, landscape.

tokens.name: card-bleed
tokens.usage: Bleed on every side.

tokens.name: card-safe
tokens.usage: Safe area inside the trim.

tokens.name: card-margin
tokens.usage: The one margin all text and marks hold from the trim.

tokens.name: card-name
tokens.usage: Chinese name, about 13.6 pt, serif bold.

tokens.name: card-small
tokens.usage: Every secondary line, about 6 pt.

tokens.name: card-lead
tokens.usage: Baseline to baseline between secondary lines.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines around panels, tiles, rows and fields, in line; the edge of the 西顶时光 field, in ink.

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: The base rule under the pillars, under figures and under a month heading, in ink. Also the focus outline.

duration.note: How long things take to change.

tokens.name: duration-control
tokens.usage: Segments and buttons changing colour.

tokens.name: duration-dot
tokens.usage: A dot of the mark responding to a pointer, ease-out.

tokens.name: duration-field
tokens.usage: A field changing colour.

tokens.name: opacity-secondary
tokens.usage: The title line under a name on a card.

tokens.name: opacity-label
tokens.usage: One-letter contact labels on a black or teal card back.
